HERO_DESCRIPTION: Learn English, French, and Russian with native-speaking teachers. Online and in-person classes: group lessons, private sessions, and real-world practice through cultural events and immersive travel experiences.
ABOUT_DESC: La Classe is a language school for those who want to speak confidently and fluently. We offer online classes, live group meetings, and real-world practice: walking tours, trips, and cultural events like Christmas market visits. Learn in a friendly atmosphere and immerse yourself in the language culture with native speakers.
ABOUT_FEATURE_1: Native-speaking teachers for English, French, and Russian
ABOUT_FEATURE_4: Materials and support after each lesson
LEVELS_DESC: We offer courses for all proficiency levels
LEVEL_A1_DESC: For those starting to learn French. Basic vocabulary, simple phrases, and foundations of grammar.
LEVEL_A2_DESC: Development of conversational skills, expanding vocabulary, working on grammar and comprehension.
SCHEDULE_DESC: All classes are held online via Zoom
SCHEDULE_A1: A1 Level - Sundays at 10:00 AM (Paris time)
SCHEDULE_A2: A2/B1 Level - Saturdays at 10:00 AM (Paris time)
TEACHER_DESC: Professional French teacher with extensive experience. I conduct lessons with love for the language and an individual approach to each student. Join us to learn French with pleasure!
TEACHER_QUOTE: Learning French should be enjoyable and engaging!
FORMAT_ITEM_2: Conversational practice with a native speaker
FORMAT_ITEM_3: Grammar explained in an accessible way
FORMAT_ITEM_4: Cultural insights and interesting facts about France
FORMAT_ITEM_5: All materials provided after each lesson
WHY_US_1_DESC: Learn in a supportive atmosphere where you want to speak and aren't afraid to make mistakes
WHY_US_2_DESC: Modern techniques focused on conversational practice
WHY_US_3_DESC: Cultural events, walking tours, travel experiences, Christmas market visits, language meetups, and an active Telegram community
TRAVEL_DESC: Join us for unforgettable language adventures
TRAVEL_NORMANDY_DESC: Combine language learning with coastal living. Enjoy intensive French courses, fresh seafood, ocean views, and explore the beauty of Normandy. Perfect for those who want to practice French while experiencing authentic French culture and cuisine.
TRAVEL_EVENTS_DESC: Christmas market tours, walking excursions, themed cultural events, and regular language practice meetups in real-world settings.
CTA_DESC: Join our Telegram channel and sign up for your first lesson!
CONTACT_DESC: Write to us on Telegram to book a lesson or get more information
